description: Save one durable fact. With page: added to that page's Current section (the page is created if new). Without page: goes to the inbox to be filed later. Write it as a plain sentence with no date; the date and source are added for you.

fact.description: The fact in plain words, e.g. "Prefers morning meetings"

page.description: Page id it belongs on, lowercase-with-hyphens, e.g. "alex-kim". Omit if unsure.

section.description: Section to add to (default Current; use Open questions for unresolved conflicts)

source.description: Where it came from, e.g. "user in chat", "email 2026-11-02"

title.description: Title for a new page, e.g. "Alex Kim"

name: remember
